decides: 产品用什么角度与景别呈现

items.prompt: front-facing close-up product shot, product fills most of the frame, centered composition
three-quarter 45-degree product angle showing depth and side details
flat-lay top-down arrangement, knolling-style neat placement of product and props
hand holding the product in close-up, natural grip showing real-world scale
candid in-use moment, natural gesture, product clearly visible in the action
extreme macro detail shot of material texture and craftsmanship, razor-thin depth of field
multi-angle grid collage of the same product, four panels, perfectly consistent lighting across panels
floating levitating product with dynamic motion elements swirling around it, gravity-defying energy
model interacting with the product, product in sharp focus in the foreground
full product lineup with packaging, family shot showing everything included in the box
